care.summary: Magnificent calathea with enormous round silvery-green leaves striped in dark green; a statement plant for any collection.
care.light: Medium to low indirect light; direct sun causes leaf scorch
care.water: Keep soil evenly moist; never let it dry out completely
care.soil: Well-draining, moisture-retentive potting mix with perlite and orchid bark
care.fertilizer: Dilute balanced fertilizer every 2-4 weeks during growing season
common_issues: Leaf edges browning from low humidity or tap water
Pest issues from stress due to improper care
tips: Wipe the large leaves gently to remove dust
Rotate plant regularly to maintain symmetrical growth
